sloka: तम् उद्वीक्ष्य सः धर्मात्मा विलपन्तम् अनाथवत् ।वाचा विक्लवया रामम् इदम् वचनम् अब्रवीत् ॥३-६८-८॥
transliteration: tam udvīkṣya saḥ dharmātmā vilapantam anāthavat ।vācā viklavayā rāmam idam vacanam abravīt ॥3-68-8॥

translations.english: Thereafter Jatayu, a piteous soul, looked up at Rama who was crying incessantly and said this in a feeble voice:
